title.narrative: Förderung einer Rechtsberatungsstelle für Tamilinnen und Tamilen im Nordosten Sri Lankas
Support for a legal advice centre for Tamils in north-eastern Sri Lanka

description.narrative: Despite the end of the civil war, Sri Lanka continues to be affected by unresolved human rights issues, particularly in the northern and eastern provinces inhabited by Tamil and Muslim minorities. Increased military presence and frequent arbitrary arrests have led to ethnic discrimination. The majority of citizens in the affected areas are unaware of their rights, and support services are rare. Particularly alarming is the increase in drug use among young people and the ongoing violence and traumatic experiences experienced by women.
